# Poolside

Use `poolside/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "poolside-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "poolside/poolside/laguna-m.1",
});
```
